tickets.summary: Refund requested for blender that arrived with a cracked jar
tickets.resolution: We issued a full refund of $89.99 to the original Visa and created a prepaid return label. Refund confirmation was emailed and will post within 3–5 business days.

tickets.summary: Charged full price after applying a 20% promo code at checkout
tickets.resolution: We verified the promo code was valid and applied a price adjustment. A $14.00 partial refund was processed back to the Mastercard ending in 2214.

tickets.summary: Requested refund for jeans that didn’t fit after using free-returns policy
tickets.resolution: Return was received and inspected in our warehouse. We refunded $54.50 to the original payment and emailed a confirmation receipt.

tickets.summary: E-book download failed repeatedly and customer wants money back
tickets.resolution: We confirmed the file error on our CDN and revoked the license. A full refund of $12.99 was issued to the Amex on file and access was removed.

tickets.summary: Locked out after too many password attempts
tickets.resolution: We verified identity via last order and billing ZIP, then cleared the lock on the account. A password reset link was sent and the customer confirmed a successful login.

tickets.summary: 2FA phone lost; cannot receive verification codes
tickets.resolution: We disabled SMS 2FA after ID verification and added an authenticator app as the new factor. Customer logged in and re-enabled SMS to a new number.

tickets.summary: SSO with Google fails due to email alias mismatch
tickets.resolution: We linked the alias to the primary account and cleared the stale OAuth tokens. Customer signed in via Google successfully on web and mobile.
We corrected a typo in the account email and removed a domain-level suppression. A fresh reset email was sent and the customer changed the password.

tickets.summary: Card charged twice after checkout error and page refresh
tickets.resolution: We found two captures for the same cart within one minute. The duplicate $42.37 charge was voided the same day and a receipt update was sent.

tickets.summary: Apple Pay double-tap caused two payments
tickets.resolution: Both transactions were authorized; one order shipped. We refunded the duplicate $68.20 authorization, which will fall off within 1–3 business days.

tickets.summary: Saw pre-authorization and final charge both posted
tickets.resolution: We confirmed the temporary hold was not released by the issuer. We contacted the processor to release the hold and sent documentation; the bank removed it within 24 hours.

tickets.summary: Monthly subscription renewed twice on same day
tickets.resolution: Two renewal jobs overlapped due to a timezone mismatch; one invoice was canceled. A $9.99 refund was issued and the next renewal date was corrected.

tickets.summary: Package shows delivered but not received
tickets.resolution: We contacted the carrier and confirmed delivery to the wrong unit. A replacement was shipped with signature required and the original was retrieved by the driver.

tickets.summary: Shipment stuck in transit for a week
tickets.resolution: We opened a trace with USPS and upgraded to priority reshipment. Replacement order went out same day and the original was marked lost after 7 days.

tickets.summary: Wrong size sneakers delivered; needs exchange
tickets.resolution: We created an exchange order for the correct size and emailed a prepaid return label. Replacement shipped once the return scanned at the carrier drop-off.

tickets.summary: Item arrived damaged with crushed box
tickets.resolution: We requested photos for QC and filed a damage claim with UPS. A new unit was sent overnight and the damaged item did not need to be returned.
